score_range.description: Each category must be scored from 0 to 5.

python_programming.description: Ability to write practical, modular Python code.

sql_database_skills.description: Ability to work with SQL databases and retrieve useful information.

api_integration.description: Experience integrating REST APIs or LLM APIs.

llm_application_development.description: Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs or GenAI APIs.

agent_frameworks.description: Exposure to LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar agent frameworks.

rag_understanding.description: Understanding of retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, chunking, and vector databases.

testing_and_quality.description: Testing mindset and ability to validate application behavior.

communication.description: Ability to communicate technical decisions and document work clearly.
